spirit:component.spirit:name: cpm6
spirit:component.spirit:description: Versal Gen 2 Adaptive Soc CPM 6 supports configuration of PCIe Gen6/CXL 3.0, DMA and Bridge blocks present in Versal Premium Gen2 devices. CPM6 block has 2 PCIe Gen6 controllers each supporting upto Gen6x8 configuration with CXL 3.0/2.0 protocol support, PCIE to AXI-MM Bridge and Hyper DMA engine
